summary: STAK Inc., a Nasdaq-listed Chinese oilfield-equipment maker, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release disclosing that its second-tier subsidiary STAK Industry Energy Ltd. signed a non-binding letter of intent for potential procurement of gas-powered generators. Indicative value of the initial proposed purchase is in the hundreds of thousands of dollars on an EXW basis, with later phases contemplated in the millions; no buyer identity, pricing, or binding volume was disclosed, and no revenue will be recognized until definitive purchase contracts are executed. This is an ordinary commercial supply arrangement, not a special situation.
